app.name: Datacenter Builder Simulator
app.tagline: Build a data center. Rate it. Certify it.
landing.feature1.title: Lego-style builder
landing.feature1.body: Drag blocks into a 32×8×32 voxel grid. Real-world dimensions. Real-world power, cooling, and security trade-offs.
landing.feature2.title: Standards-cited scoring
landing.feature2.body: Your build is rated against Uptime Institute, TIA-942, EN 50600, ASHRAE, NFPA, ISO 27001, and the EU/SG/DE/CN energy codes.
landing.feature3.title: Verifiable certificate
landing.feature3.body: Download an SVG certificate with a QR code. Optionally push to Credly as a portable digital badge.

consent.title: We respect your privacy
consent.body: We do not use third-party analytics by default. If you opt in, we collect anonymous, aggregated usage data to improve the simulator. You can change this at any time in Settings.

settings.intro: Locale, analytics consent, and your local data.
settings.language.hint: Affects UI text. Page reloads after change.
settings.analytics.hint: We do not run any third-party scripts by default. If you opt in, we collect anonymous page views and Web Vitals. You can change this at any time.

help.title: Help & FAQ
help.faq.a1: A pure-frontend simulator that lets you build a data center in a 3D Lego-style grid, then rate your design against international standards (Uptime, TIA-942, ASHRAE, NFPA, ISO 27001, EU EED, etc.).
help.faq.q2: Do I need to sign up?
help.faq.a2: No. Sign in with a crypto wallet (MetaMask, Phantom, WalletConnect). No email, no password.
help.faq.a3: In your browser's IndexedDB. Nothing is sent to a server unless you choose to publish to Credly.
help.faq.a4: Yes — the share button copies a URL that re-imports your build on the recipient's machine.
